correctness.rationale: For every binary word, the literal nonadjacent 00/11 counts recover the exact number of zero/one runs, so the fibre cannot leave its run stratum. The <=3-run cases are reconstructed from first-symbol orientation and one mixed count, except 01 vs 10. For four runs, the single internal reversal gives G10=bc-1 in the 0-starting case or G01=bc-1 in the 1-starting case; every bounded factor pair reconstructs precisely one word, with no hidden case. The fixed-composition profile count is the union of a bounded multiplication table and its reflection, and the K+1 equal-population construction realizes tau(K) exactly because its reflected product exceeds K^2. The attached program calculates every deck literally and passed 8094 words, 5611 classes, 529 multiplication-table grids and 120 divisor examples; those finite checks are corroboration, not a proof of the unlimited assertion.

value.rationale: Gapped multiset reconstruction is a motivated inverse problem; the four-run stratum is the first nondegenerate bounded-run setting with ambiguity. Instead of supplying a single small collision, the theorem classifies all its inverse fibres, computes the exact number of distinguishable codewords for each fixed composition as a multiplication-table union, and constructs arbitrarily large fibres governed exactly by the divisor function. This is a natural complete classification with a sharp structural boundary, not a relabeling or an arbitrary finite search result.
